name: UI: bell notification + warning blink on task and session icons until the user acts
description:
UI repository: /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/client (Vue 3 + Tailwind/daisyUI + Pinia-style stores).

!! DO NOT CALL project_map / project_locate / project_trace / project_impact !! They time out (120s each) and previously consumed the whole 900s worker turn. Read the four files below directly (they are small) and edit them.

PREREQUISITE (done by the API step): the session payload now carries `needs_user: boolean` and a warning notification is emitted on handoff.

KNOWN ANCHORS: client/src/store/ui.js — `addNotification` around line 276 plus the notifications state; client/src/components/Notifications.vue — the bell/dropdown list; client/src/components/chat/ChatIcon.vue — tiny component, `props: ['mode']`, renders a fa icon per mode class; client/src/components/browsers/BrowserSessionList.vue — the session rail/list.

WORK:
1. Bell: make sure the warning notification emitted by the API reaches `uiStore.addNotification` and renders in Notifications.vue with the warning colour and a link/label pointing at the session. Reuse the existing socket/notification handler and styling — do not invent a second channel.
2. Blink the task icon: extend ChatIcon.vue with an optional `attention` (or `warn`) boolean prop. When true, wrap the icon with `text-warning animate-pulse` (keep the existing mode colours otherwise) and set a tooltip like 'Needs your attention'. The component is used in chat lists/cards, so the parent that already knows the chat/session must pass the prop — find that usage by reading the component that renders ChatIcon (search the imports with project_read_file pattern if needed) and pass `:attention="chatNeedsUser"` computed from the notification/session state you already load there. If ChatIcon is used in many places, keep the prop optional/defaulting to false so nothing breaks.
3. Blink the session icon: in BrowserSessionList.vue (and the single-session header if it lives in the same file) add `text-warning animate-pulse` to the session icon when `session.needs_user` is true, plus a small 'Needs you' badge; it must stop blinking once the user takes control (the flag turns false after `take_control`).
4. State must survive reload: derive it from the loaded session payload / persistent notifications, not from a transient local variable.

REPORT: files changed, the prop/class added, where the attention flag is computed from, and the build/typecheck result (run `npm run build` or `npx vue-tsc --noEmit` if a shell is available; if not, say explicitly that the check was not run).

ACCEPTANCE: notification appears in the bell in warning colour; task icon and session icon blink in warning colour while `needs_user`; blinking stops after take-control; no console errors; existing icon/notification behaviour unchanged when the flag is false.

I'll inspect the surrounding code to find the ChatIcon consumers and the socket notification path.Now I'll apply the changes. Starting with the store (`ui.js`): preserve notification fields and add an attention getter.## Changes applied

**1. Bell / notification channel — `client/src/store/ui.js`**
- `addNotification(state, notification)`: now accepts a string *or* an object and **preserves the sender's extra fields** (`title`, `session_id`, `chat_id`, `needs_user`, …) instead of reducing the event to `{ts,text,type}`; adds a stable `id` (the list uses it as `v-for` key and it was `undefined` before, causing duplicate-key warnings); normalises a string argument; auto-dismiss stays 30 s but handoff notifications get 5 min so the entry can't get stuck.
- New getters:
  - `attentionChatIds` → chat ids of sessions whose payload has `needs_user` (via `session.chat_id`),
  - `hasAttention` → any session needs the user.
  Both derive from the **loaded session payload**, so they survive a reload and clear by themselves.

**2. `client/src/store/session.js`** — the existing socket handler `if (type === 'notification') { $storex.ui.addNotification(data) }` is unchanged as the single channel; it now additionally calls `$storex.browsers.loadSessions()` when `data.needs_user` is set, so the rail/chat icon blink as soon as the handoff arrives, with the API remaining the source of truth for the flag.

**3. `client/src/components/Notifications.vue`** — warning entries get a link button (`notificationSessionId()` / `openSession()` → `$storex.browsers.selectSession()` + closes the card). Rendered only when the notification carries `session_id` / `sessionId` / `machine_id`; label `notif.session_name || 'Open the machine'` in `text-warning`.

**4. `client/src/components/chat/ChatIcon.vue`** — new optional prop `attention` (Boolean, default `false`); root span gets `animate-pulse` and tooltip `'Needs your attention'`; `iconColor(base)` swaps the mode colour for `text-warning` while attention is true. Defaults keep every existing usage byte-identical in behaviour.

**5. `client/src/components/chat/ChatCard.vue`** and **`ChatSidebarNode.vue`** — pass `:attention="chatNeedsUser"`, computed as `this.$storex.ui.attentionChatIds.includes(this.chat?.id)`.

**6. `client/src/components/browsers/BrowserSessionList.vue`**
- collapsed rail: `sessionItemClass()` returns `bg-warning/15 text-warning animate-pulse` when `session.needs_user` + an `animate-pulse` warning dot; tooltip gets `SESSION_LABELS.needsYouHint`;
- expanded list: new `sessionAvatarClass()` (warning + pulse), a `badge badge-warning animate-pulse` with the existing centralised label `SESSION_LABELS.needsYou`, and the tooltip line.
- nothing blinks when the flag is false; after take-control the API clears `needs_user` and the classes disappear on the next payload.

## Verification
- Re-read every edited region (`project_read_file`) and the resulting diff (`project_changes`) — all edits landed once, in place, with the original indentation/formatting preserved.
- Existing behaviour on `attention === false`: ChatIcon colour map, tooltip (`mode`), notification text/type handling and all session row classes are unchanged (only the string/int defaults were extended).
- **`npm run build` / `vue-tsc --noEmit` were NOT run:** this worker has no shell/host exec tool, and the running containers (`codx-junior-client` etc.) build from images, not from this working tree.

## Notes / assumptions
- The session→chat link is assumed to be `session.chat_id` (the field the browsers store already writes when creating a session).
- For the bell link to appear, the API notification should include `session_id` (and `needs_user: true` if it is a handoff); without it the warning entry still renders, just without the link.

/**
 * Reads a label by key and fills its `{name}` placeholders.
 *
 * Falls back to the key itself so a typo or a not-yet-migrated caller never
 * renders `undefined` in the UI.
 *
 * @param {string} key key of {@link SESSION_LABELS}
 * @param {Record<string, string|number>} [vars] values for the placeholders
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function label(key, vars) {
  const text = SESSION_LABELS[key] ?? key
  if (!vars) return text
  return String(text).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, name) => (
    vars[name] === undefined || vars[name] === null ? match : String(vars[name])
  ))
}
